Atmo_GasGiant.note: thin warm haze at the limb only

Planet_Earth.note: NASA Blue Marble day map + Black Marble 2012 city lights (public domain); clouds = one frame of the NASA GEOS-5 atmospheric MODEL (SVS 3837), not observed or current weather; slow drift is artistic

Planet_Eyeball.note: tidally locked; open water around the substellar point (uses SunDirection), ice elsewhere

Solar_Jupiter.note: Cassini PIA07782 cylindrical map (Dec 2000): a snapshot of cloud features

Solar_Mars.note: USGS Viking MDIM2.1 colour mosaic (public domain); fine detail procedural

Solar_Moon.note: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit LROC colour + LOLA relief (NormalStrength 2 = relief exaggerated x2 for readability); fine crater detail procedural

meshes.annulus_note: disk radius 50 cm with a 2% hole; U = r / R_outer (0.02..1), V = angle/2pi; set InnerRadiusFraction = inner/outer per ring or disk

T_Noise_Perlin.note: tileable gradient noise, RGBA = 4 octaves (4,8,16,32 cells)

T_Noise_Cells.note: tileable Worley: R=F1, G=F2-F1, B=cell id, A=crater height

T_Starfield.note: procedural soft galactic glow only (stars are drawn procedurally in M_CosmosSky), J2000 ecliptic orientation (artistic)

T_Blank_sRGB.note: 4x4 black sRGB default for optional colour maps

T_LensLut_Placeholder.note: 4x4 zero default for the lens ray tables (runtime R32F/RGBA32F from lead)

T_Moon_Day.note: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit LROC colour 8192x4096 (Solar/SOURCES.json)

T_Moon_Slope.note: slopes from LOLA LDEM16 (R=east, G=north, x8 encoding; Solar/SOURCES.json)

T_Earth_Day.note: NASA Blue Marble cloud-free day map 8192x4096 (public domain; Earth/SOURCES.json)

T_Earth_Clouds.note: cloud coverage from one NASA GEOS-5 model frame 2048x1024 (SVS 3837; Earth/SOURCES.json)

T_Earth_Night.note: NASA Black Marble 2012 night lights 8192x4096 (public domain; Earth/SOURCES.json)

T_Ring_Saturn.note: ring radial profile R=density G=brightness B=fine structure

T_Ring_Icy.note: ring radial profile R=density G=brightness B=fine structure

notes.en: Exoplanet surfaces are artistic hypotheses, not observed maps. Material parameters never change physics.
